run_dashboard_main: run the main function to collect Argilla dataset progress and upload to Hugging Face Hub
get_dataset_progress: get the progress statistics for a language dataset with automatic retry on API errors
flatten_user_stats: flatten nested Argilla user submission stats into a flat list of dictionaries
update_progress_data: combine new Argilla progress data with existing NDJSON data and save the result
get_dataset_for_language: retrieve a specific Argilla dataset object by its language code prefix
